title: Barrow Nave
shortDescription: The hill's inside, peat-stained bronze, three slow pulses.
longDescription:
The nave is packed earth and old timber. Peat-stain climbs the walls. The air is cold and wet, not sweet.
Half-sunk in the floor is Collegium bronze — or the yoke and clapper if the hill grew around the rest. It should not ring. It sounds the three slow pulses anyway. Holm wrote that the bell was taken on a wet night. This is where it was taken to.

fixtures.name: Abbey Bronze
fixtures.lookDescription: Peat-stained bronze half-sunk in the hill. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: Green with peat-stain. Half-sunk as if the hill grew around it. The Quiet Chapel was telling the truth: three slow pulses live in the metal. It should not ring, and it does not, and you hear it anyway. Holm's ledger said the bronze was taken on a wet night. This is the resting place. Do not try to hang it. Talk alder with the fact.
